engine._note: About a 1.7 L four: ~115 hp at about 6000 rpm, 158 N·m at 4500. torqueCurve is full-throttle torque at the flywheel (rpm, N·m), what a dyno shows. friction (base + perKrpm·k + perKrpm2·k², k = rpm/1000, N·m) is what's left with the throttle shut: engine braking. inertia is the crank and flywheel (kg·m²). The idle controller opens the throttle to hold idleRpm; the rev limiter cuts fuel at redlineRpm and restores it limiter.hysteresis rpm lower. induction: 'natural' (loses torque in thin air, in proportion to the air density) or 'turbo' / 'supercharged' (full torque for now; boost making up for altitude comes later). cylinders: a firing every 720 / cylinders degrees (misfires, the sound). sound: its sound config (the files the game plays, data/sounds/engines).

overRev._note: What the engine takes past its redline, when the wheels drive it there (a downshift at too high a speed: the rev limiter can't stop that). Bands are fractions over redlineRpm. From valveFloat the valves float: it stutters and drags harder (drag × friction per bentValves over) while it's there, and wears floatWear condition points a second at the top of the band. From bentValves, bendTime s there and the valves hit the pistons: the condition drops bentLoss points (up to 1.6× that at the top of the band), then bentWear a second while it stays there. From blown, blowTime s there and it's blown: a bang and smoke, the engine stops and the car coasts; condition 0 until it's repaired in the garage. Below misfireBelow condition it misfires: up to `misfire` of its firings lost at condition 0, so it runs rough and down on power. A tougher engine (or forged internals) takes more.
